summary: Missing validation for the JWT_SECRET environment variable causes unhandled runtime exceptions when signing tokens.

findings.title: Unvalidated JWT_SECRET environment variable
findings.body: jwt.sign is invoked directly with process.env.JWT_SECRET without verifying that the secret is set, causing jsonwebtoken to throw a runtime error if the environment variable is missing or undefined.
findings.recommendation: Validate that process.env.JWT_SECRET exists and is non-empty before signing, throwing a clear configuration error if it is not configured.
